newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ANGLOVAAL DETAILS GOLD, MINERAL RESTRUCTURE.
newsitem.headline: ANGLOVAAL DETAILS GOLD, MINERAL RESTRUCTURE.

text.p: Anglovaal Ltd on Wednesday announced details of a radical reorganisation of its gold holdings and strategic mineral and mining interests into two new companies, Avgold Ltd and Avmin Ltd.
Target Exploration Co Ltd would become the sole vehicle for developing and holding its gold interests, Anglovaal said in a statement. Target would be renamed Avgold.
Middle Witwatersrand (Western Areas) Ltd will become the principal vehicle for holding the minerals and mining investments and will be renamed Avmin.
The reorganisation of the gold holdings will involve Target purchasing with effect from November 1 for a total of 1.04 billion rand the following:
- East Transvaal Consolidated Mines Ltd (ET Cons) for 274.7 million rand
- Hartebeesfontein Gold Mining Co Ltd (Harties) for 373.3 million rand
- Loraine Gold Mines Ltd for 102.4 million rand
- Oribi Prospecting and Mining Co Ltd for 51.5 million rand and Sun Prospecting and Mining Co Ltd for 231.9 million rand
- and Anglovaal/Mid Wits assets.
In addition Anglovaal will be cancelling its management contracts with ET Cons, Harties and Loraine from November 1, which will each be settled by a cash payment from Target.

Anglovaal said the reconstituted Avgold would have gold production of about 1.1 million ounces a year and total gold resources of about 62.18 million ounces. Avgold would pursue exploration for gold resources elsewhere in Africa and abroad.
The reorganisation of the mining and mineral interests will entail a number of transactions in which Mid Wits will acquire from November 1 for a total amount of 2.66 billion rand, the following:

- Anglovaal's 45.7 percent stake in Sun, its 51 percent stake in Oribi and the non-gold mining interests. The latter includes a 15 percent effective holding by ET Cons in the Nkomati base metals project
- Renounceable letters of allocation in respect of 8.79 million ordinary shares in Target
- 34.17 million ordinary Target shares and 8.51 million Target debentures from the Anglovaal Group.
Payment will be settled partially by the allotment and issue of 128.22 million new Mid Wits shares and 385.9 million rand in cash and other assets.

Furthermore Mid Wits will sell its gold assets to Target from November 1. The sale price was not provided but Anglovaal said payment would be settled by the issue to Mid Wits of 347,479 new Target shares.
Anglovaal said there were significant growth opportunities in all of Avmin's investments and operations based on currently identified unexploited mineral resources.
Avmin was continuously looking at international expansion opportunities, it said.
No application had been made for the removal of ring fencing of operations for taxation purposes.

Anglovaal said the various transactions in the formation of Avgold and Avmin were dependent on a number of conditions and approvals from parties including shareholders, the central Reserve Bank and the Minister of Mineral and Energy Affairs.
-- Johannesburg newsroom 27 11 482 1003
